evals.prompt: Pick up dev work on this project — start building against the spec.
evals.expected_output: Finds specs/2026-09-05-pdf-rag.md, builds notebooks/mvp.ipynb to validate the ingest->chunk->embed->retrieve->answer flow before touching src/, breaks the remaining build into ordered increments, checks in rather than running to completion silently, writes tests per increment, and does not silently deviate from the spec's chosen stack (LangChain/PyMuPDF/Chroma/Ollama/Streamlit).
files: copy of test_rag project with CLAUDE.md + specs/2026-09-05-pdf-rag.md, empty src/ and notebooks/

assertions.text: Read specs/2026-09-05-pdf-rag.md before writing any code
assertions.evidence_hint: transcript/session log references the spec's content

assertions.text: Built or clearly attempted notebooks/mvp.ipynb before (or instead of) writing src/ modules
assertions.evidence_hint: notebooks/mvp.ipynb exists with cells for ingest->chunk->embed->retrieve->answer

assertions.text: Did not silently substitute a different stack than the spec names (LangChain, PyMuPDF, sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, ChromaDB, Ollama/llama3.2, Streamlit)
assertions.evidence_hint: code/requirements match spec's stack, or a substitution is explicitly flagged with reasoning

assertions.text: Broke work into ordered increments rather than attempting the whole spec in one undifferentiated pass
assertions.evidence_hint: session log or commit history shows a slice-by-slice plan

assertions.text: Surfaced at least one check-in / stopping point rather than running silently to a self-declared finish
assertions.evidence_hint: session log shows a checkpoint report of what's built vs. left

assertions.text: Wrote at least one test for code it built, distinct from the full eval suite
assertions.evidence_hint: a test file or inline sanity check accompanies new src/ code

assertions.text: Did not declare the feature 'done'/'shippable' itself — leaves final certification to release-qa or says so explicitly
assertions.evidence_hint: no self-certifying language like 'ready to ship'

assertions.text: Honestly flagged any dependency that couldn't actually run in this sandbox (Ollama, model download) instead of fabricating a working result
assertions.evidence_hint: session log names the specific blocker rather than claiming success

evals.prompt: Start building an expense-splitting app for roommates — track shared expenses and who owes whom.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes there is no specs/ directory / finalized spec and architecture for this idea, says this isn't app-developer's job, and points back to app-architect instead of improvising a stack and starting to code.
files: fresh empty-ish project dir with only a placeholder README.md, no specs/

assertions.text: Recognized there is no specs/ directory or finalized architecture for this idea before acting
assertions.evidence_hint: session log names the missing spec/scaffold explicitly

assertions.text: Declined to unilaterally pick a stack/architecture and start writing app code
assertions.evidence_hint: no framework/library choice made and committed to as if final

assertions.text: Pointed the user back to a planning/spec step (app-architect or equivalent) rather than improvising
assertions.evidence_hint: session log or reply explicitly names the hand-back

assertions.text: Did not produce a scaffolded app (src/ files, chosen DB/framework) in outputs/
assertions.evidence_hint: outputs/ directory contains no speculative app implementation
